raw_content:
rules:
  - id: vuln-git-client-plugin-75ea3fe0
    patterns:
      - pattern: File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX, $WORKSPACE)
      - pattern-not: Files.createTempFile($PATH, $PREFIX, $SUFFIX)
      - pattern-not: Files.createTempFile($PATH, $PREFIX, $SUFFIX, $FILE_ATTRIBUTE)
      - pattern-not: createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX)
    pattern-inside: |
      class $CLASS {
        ...
      }
    message: "Use of File.createTempFile with workspace parameter may lead to insecure temporary file creation. The patch introduces proper permission handling for temporary files on non-Windows systems by using Files.createTempFile with PosixFilePermissions. Replace File.createTempFile calls that use workspace directories with the new createTempFile method that ensures secure permissions."
    languages: [java]
    severity: ERROR
    metadata:
      source-url: github.com/jenkinsci/git-client-plugin/commit/75ea3fe05650fc6ca09046a72493e2b3f066fb98
      category: security
      cwe: [CWE-377]
